items.label: Assistant: timeout ends as Response stopped (~140s)
items.intendedBehavior: HttpClient/Ollama timeouts surface a friendly retry message; Grok fallback on timeout.
items.expectedResult: Retry/help text — not 'Response stopped.' from OperationCanceledException.

items.label: Assistant: Grok fallback on timeout (not only empty reply)
items.intendedBehavior: Escalate to Grok when local stream times out or is cancelled.
items.expectedResult: Grok path invoked after local timeout.

items.label: Assistant prompt box resets to default after send
items.intendedBehavior: Preserve empty prompt or clerk-typed text after send; do not overwrite with default.
items.expectedResult: Input stays cleared or retains typed text — not default placeholder prompt.

items.label: User guide cites nonexistent Ask Advanced button
items.intendedBehavior: Guide matches UI (no manual Ask Advanced; auto-Grok only).
items.expectedResult: No 'Ask Advanced' affordance promised in guide/tour.

items.label: Create deadline appears enabled until text entered
items.intendedBehavior: Disabled state clearly visible when NL field empty.
items.expectedResult: Button visibly disabled OR helper text before typing.

items.label: Deadlines render midnight–1AM not all-day
items.intendedBehavior: Clerk-facing all-day deadlines on calendar.
items.expectedResult: All-day events without 12–1AM slot span.

items.label: Recurring deadlines do not roll forward
items.intendedBehavior: Recurring CO deadlines advance after occurrence.
items.expectedResult: Next instance appears after due date passes.

items.label: Document grid row click selects / previews
items.intendedBehavior: Clicking row selects document and shows preview.
items.expectedResult: Row click updates preview without checkbox-only.

items.label: Upload times shown as local not UTC
items.intendedBehavior: Uploaded timestamps in clerk local timezone.
items.expectedResult: Displayed time matches local offset.

items.label: User guide opens on repeated clicks
items.intendedBehavior: Open user guide dialog every time.
items.expectedResult: Dialog visible after second Open user guide click.

items.label: Page help (i) click opens help (not hover-only)
items.intendedBehavior: Click or keyboard opens persistent help panel.
items.expectedResult: Dialog/drawer on click; not tooltip-only.

items.label: Dashboard Upload document opens file picker
items.intendedBehavior: Navigate to documents and focus uploader / file picker.
items.expectedResult: File input focused or chooser opens.

items.label: Settings embedding reindex control visible
items.intendedBehavior: Clerk can trigger reindex from Settings when API is up.
items.expectedResult: Reindex embeddings button visible and enabled when connected (missing on prod e1c5399 walkthrough).

items.label: Print council packet prints packet not entire page
items.intendedBehavior: Print styled council packet PDF/preview.
items.expectedResult: Print job targets packet content, not full SPA chrome.

items.label: Two Settings tour entry points do not duplicate same tour
items.intendedBehavior: Distinct tours or single entry.
items.expectedResult: Page tour ≠ tools tour ≠ replay tour.

items.label: /account loads with auth; secrets not exposed
items.intendedBehavior: Auth enforced on LAN; /account 200 for signed-in clerk; keys gated.
items.expectedResult: No HTTP 500; unauthenticated users blocked from keys.

items.label: Town helper status not contradictory
items.intendedBehavior: Ready vs offline mutually exclusive; probe includes model health.
items.expectedResult: Cannot show Ready and Ollama offline together.

items.label: Dashboard Overdue pill contrast ≥4.5:1
items.intendedBehavior: WCAG AA text contrast on urgency counts.
items.expectedResult: Contrast ratio ≥ 4.5:1 (prod walkthrough: 3.06:1).

items.label: Grid filter inputs accessible name
items.intendedBehavior: Filter inputs labelled for screen readers.
items.expectedResult: No aria-label _Filter; human-readable column names.

items.label: Add requirement navigates only (no create dialog)
items.intendedBehavior: Quick-add opens create requirement dialog or prefilled form.
items.expectedResult: Create dialog on Requirements after click.
